requirements.title: Mission Control must expose tool governance replay
requirements.acceptance_boundary: covered when Mission Control includes tool_governance_replay with governance status, counts, replay items, and not-proven boundary

requirements.title: Tool replay must be derived from canonical agent-session tool_call events
requirements.acceptance_boundary: covered when tests assert replay source session, counts, decisions, and risk class from the current session artifact

forecast.estimated_token_cost_range: bounded Mission Control projection release verification
forecast.forecast_boundary: forecast is release planning evidence, not delivery certainty

not_proven: Requirement coverage proves structural linkage only; it does not prove semantic truth, provider behavior, production safety, or unrecorded tool-call absence.
